A natural, highly realistic editorial business photograph of a single 36-year-old man, average build, bald, a completely clean-shaven and freshly shaved face, smooth cheeks and jawline, no visible stubble, no beard and no mustache, blue eyes, without glasses.

Natural depth of field, realistic optical rendering, fine fabric texture, visible skin pores, subtle under-eye detail, natural body proportions and anatomically correct hands. Authentic corporate editorial photography, restrained retouching, slight photographic grain, subtle lens softness, realistic exposure, no artificial glamour, no glossy advertising look.
